# Pick the lock: Here you can find locks for challenges

![Pick the lock: Here you can find locks for challenges](/uploads/316_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

If you want to complete the World Challenges "Pick Locks" on all levels, you will need a lot of locks. And for the daily challenges you occasionally need a lock that you can pick. Here you will find a map with castles divided into levels so that you can look for suitable castles.

## Lock picking challenges

- World: **Pick Locks.** (1/5/10/50/75/100/250/750)
- Daily Challenge: **Pick a lock.** 

## Fun Fact: Cut Content Challenges (no longer available)

- Pick a lock while intoxicated.
- Pick a lock while naked.
- Pick a lock at night.
- Pick locks during the Vault 94 mission "Meltdown".
